lines.1: Day two of the Sports and Martial Arts Festival.
lines.2: 「Helping out yesterday was rough, but today I'll make up for it by going all out over here.」
lines.3: 「Oh yeah, thanks for the expository dialogue.」
lines.4: 「Still, our Western Army isn't looking too hot.」
lines.5: 「Then I at least need to take first in the events I'm in.」
lines.9: 「Heh. Bad luck getting the same running order as me.」
lines.11: 「Who the hell is that!? I'm Murata!」
lines.12: 「Sounds like Konoe from my class has been in your debt lately... but I'm not going easy on you.」
lines.13: 「Hmph. I'd be pissed if you did.」
lines.15: 「I think she's a lot like you.」
lines.17: I couldn't lose to this guy--Murata.
lines.18: This borrowing race still had the usual slips with requests written on them halfway around the track--
lines.19: But if you decided the request on your slip was impossible,
lines.20: there was another slip near the finish line, and you could choose to follow that request instead.
lines.21: Going all the way to the finish-line slip cost a lot of time, but apparently its requests were relatively easy.
lines.22: That was where the strategy came in.
lines.23: Take the shortcut and fulfill a hard request, or take the long way around for an easier one.
lines.26: 「Oh... Tsushima and Murata are in the same heat.」
lines.27: 「Well, Tsushima doesn't stand a chance against Murata.」
lines.37: 「That Murata took off without a second's hesitation.」
lines.47: I took off with the Princess.
lines.48: 「Damn you, Tsushima, you're fast! Konoe, can you pick up the pace!?」
lines.51: 「Ghh... I was so close to catching you.」
lines.52: 「Well, luck is part of skill too.」
lines.53: The Princess's speed was ridiculous, so I managed to win.
lines.55: 「You sound exhausted. Don't force yourself to talk.」
lines.59: 「He's right. You were tired, so it couldn't be helped. Sorry I pushed you too hard.」
lines.63: 「Fine. I'm up next... Now I'm pissed. I don't care how tired I am.」
lines.67: 「Hah. I passed the girl from your class and took first.」
lines.70: I was starting to feel sorry for her.
lines.71: Third-year speed skating, 1st place: Otome Kurogane
lines.72: 「I'm used to fighting on any terrain. Ice won't make me lose!」
lines.73: 「Otome-san really is amazing. Even as the enemy, gotta respect her.」
lines.74: 「The school itself is pretty amazing too... An ice rink just rises straight up from underground.」
lines.75: 「That's why there are more helicopters too, you know.」
lines.76: 「So publicity really does rule the world.」
lines.77: 「Having real substance to back it up is the most important part, though.」
lines.78: Second-year cavalry battle, 1st place: Erika Kiriya
lines.79: 「All right! First place in a special event!!」
lines.80: A cavalry battle on actual horses.
lines.81: Experience gave a huge advantage, but the Princess was impressive all the same.
lines.82: 「...And we still can't beat the Eastern Army.」
lines.83: The points gap had opened too wide at the start.
lines.84: At least I was glad I'd won my own event.
